This development follows a purification ritual at a rally venue addressed by Mallikarjun Kharge.

title: Raksha Bandhan reunion ends in tragedy as truck kills 2 sisters in UP

The family was returning home from a Raksha Bandhan celebration when the horrific incident took place on Sunday. Alongside the fatalities, three individuals, including a six-month-old baby, were injured. The truck driver fled the scene, and police are actively pursuing him as part of their investigation.

description: In a shocking incident, an Aam Aadmi Party member was fatally shot while his friend sustained injuries in Mamdot market, Ferozepur. The assailants, armed and determined, pursued the victims on their motorcycle and fired at them. Rushed to the hospital, the party member was pronounced dead upon arrival. Initial investigations point to election-related rivalry as the possible motive.

title: Texas rancher said no to wind turbines twice; royalties now help his ranch
description: A fifth-generation West Texas rancher twice rejected wind turbines on his family property before agreeing to host seven turbines from the Cactus Flats wind project. Since 2019, the regular wind income has helped cover ranching costs, from livestock feed and workers to fences and repairs. The project also helped him invest in a community site in Menard, showing how wind royalties can support traditional ranching and rural development.

title: Delhi's new fire safety rules: What property owners, developers need to know
description: In an effort to bolster city safety, new fire safety regulations have been implemented for buildings in Delhi. These updated guidelines, part of the Unified Building Bye-Laws, encompass eighteen crucial categories, including provision for fire engine access and secured exits. Additionally, structures are now required to maintain emergency power and continuous monitoring systems, all in response to recent fire incidents that highlighted the need for stronger protections.

title: Iceland rejects EU membership talks, puts fishing rights and sovereignty first
description: Icelanders have decisively chosen to reject the idea of reopening talks for European Union membership. This choice reflects a strong commitment to maintaining national sovereignty and control over important fishing waters. While supporters believed this could enhance economic and security stability, critics were concerned about potential loss of independence. This referendum effectively concludes a prolonged discussion regarding Iceland's role on the global stage.

title: How to avoid rental disputes: Delhi Police plans awareness session for Northeast tenants
description: Delhi Police will host an awareness program next week for Northeast residents.  The event will focus on rental agreements and security deposit issues.  Tenants will learn about their rights and responsibilities regarding rent.  Police will widely circulate advisories with community leaders' help.  This initiative aims to prevent and resolve landlord-tenant disputes effectively.

title: A Colombian man helped create Lego-like bricks from recycled plastic
description: A Colombian architect helped develop Lego-like building blocks made from recycled plastic and rubber to create temporary and permanent homes. The system was used to build shelters for 42 displaced families in Guapi in 2015. Four people could assemble a 40-square-metre house in five days, without using glue, cement or water.
